original_test_intent: Apply an approved all-LED on or off override, observe the intended LEDs, then release control to the original policy without reset.
original_method: Original Master source is retained verbatim; Review adds a safe bounded method.
manual_activity: Owner approves LED population, mode, observation method, duration and release/recovery.
agent_execution_scope: Run only the bounded approved command
engineer_actions: Approve inputs, limits and recovery; own DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not accepted blindly; missing fields, credential handling and semantic coverage were corrected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture baseline, issue one exact approved 0x30/0x23 mode, verify mapped LEDs, then send release-control 0x00 and confirm original policy resumes.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Original fields/timing are preserved and absent bytes are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture baseline, issue one exact approved 0x30/0x23 mode, verify mapped LEDs, then send release-control 0x00 and confirm original policy resumes.

modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Command completion without visual/telemetry evidence is partial only.

project_override_considerations: Alternate tools are allowed only with approved equivalence and explicit disclosure of unverified original-tool/raw-command coverage.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master has placeholder Request1, omits interface/target mapping, and incorrectly says BMC factory reset as a criterion for an LED command.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Core operation is identifiable; target values and approval are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Removes the erroneous factory-reset expectation and makes LED override reversible and observable.
independent_technical_reasoning: The command controls indicators, not BMC configuration reset. PASS requires the expected physical/telemetry state and successful release; accepting a reset would both violate intent and create unrelated destructive coverage.
